title: The Only Character Questionnaire You Need
use_cases: Use when developing nuanced and multidimensional protagonists
Use when drafting speculative fiction requiring adapted character profiles
Use when building a foundational character backstory before writing
Configure when adjusting character traits for science fiction or fantasy settings
content:
Complete this character questionnaire for your main characters even if you never use the information in your book. It will help you to see them as three-dimensional, nuanced beings who leave marks on many people’s lives.

If you are writing speculative fiction, adjust the questions for the worlds you create in science fiction, fantasy, or magic realism.
